styleSelection.reason: High key double portrait: transparent warm value planes with crisp eyes and a sparse sepia drawing. Fine fur and whiskers belong to the line layer; hair remains a painted dark mass.

families.referenceCue: Tabby head: ochre and sienna patches over near-white fur, upward gaze, asymmetrical eye size, triangular ears, white muzzle. Dry controlled wash; short growth strokes around the nose and swept locks at the cheek; retain long pale whisker gaps.

Large unpainted white chest with a narrow warm left leg and darker right shoulder. Broad connected pale local washes, then one turning shadow from cheek through shoulder; sparse downward fur lines only in the warm shadow.

Dark charcoal crown and temple locks against bare paper; broken silhouette, clear paper holes, deepest valleys inside the mass. Connected dilute mixed neutral base, dry shadow glazes, only a few curved closing lines.

Pale warm face, nearly bare forehead and nose ridge; tilted eye line, two brown irises and light sclera, dark brows, small nostrils and a gentle smile. Dry local planes and focal details; cross-boundary shadow through left temple, cheek and lower jaw. No pen under-eye crease.
